changesDuringSelfReview.reason: Keep terminal/end-point scope, avoid narrowing to cable termination process.
Natural Vietnamese for damage; no added bend radius or cleaning procedure.

semanticChecks: All163canonical units reviewed in both own locales against Japanese;56fullparagraphs translated without summary substitution.
Optical versus metallic electrical-signal transmission, mechanical support and equipment power supply treated separately.

Core/cladding refractive-index relationship, outer covering/jacket, fibre structure versus cable structure retained;20/100/400 fibre counts are examples and do not equal cable diameters or inner core counts.
No universal nylon coating claim; silica and plastic-cladding type scope retained; no inferred bend-radius or cleaning instructions.
Coaxial central conductor, insulation, outer conductor and outer protection distinguished; UTP means unshielded twisted pair; no universal cost/flexibility comparison.
LAN category and matched product number do not establish actual overall system speed or completed connections.
Messenger/suspension support does not imply zero cable load; integrated support does not waive mounting/design checks.
Payout equipment distinguished from route-side pulleys/rollers; drum/coiled form and product-specific compatibility retained.
Aerial and underground optical closures retained; external position differs from fibre correspondence/internal connection verification.
Tensioning versus gripping roles distinguished without asserting two devices always required; integrated-function products retained.
Rectifier AC-to-DC conversion separate from battery energy storage/charge/discharge; backup existence does not guarantee duration or adequacy.
Fusion splicing joins optical fibre connection sections, not entire jackets; mechanical splice and connector alternatives retained without choosing processing conditions.
Protective sleeve, holder and coating-removal tools have distinct roles; model compatibility and loss/quality checks distinct from visible connection.
limitations: Author self-review only; no cross-author reading or peer review.
